messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 42):
"""
Name & Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer "This is to confirm that the information furnished above is true. The Company shall comply with extant Regulations with regard to the obligations towards all the existing Policyholders. Further, a notice period of 90 days has been provided to every existing policyholder prior to withdrawal of the Product (Not applicable to Life Insurers).” Place Name and Signature of the principal officer Company’s seal Date: 43 Annexure-6 Sl. No.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What notice period must be provided to existing policyholders before a health insurance product is withdrawn?","answer":"A notice period of 90 days must be provided to every existing policyholder prior to withdrawal of the product.","facts":["\"Further, a notice period of 90 days has been provided to every existing policyholder prior to withdrawal of the Product\""]},{"question":"Does the 90‑day notice period requirement apply to life insurers?","answer":"No, the 90‑day notice period does not apply to life insurers.","facts":["\"Not applicable to Life Insurers\""]}]}
